registry.description: Humility is the accurate assessment of one's own position before God and others — not self-deprecation or false modesty but the clear-eyed recognition that one is a creature, dependent, limited, and in need. The Hebrew and Greek vocabulary covers lowness, poverty of spirit, and the willingness to take the lower place. God consistently works with and through the humble: he resists the proud but gives grace to the humble. Humility is not a diminishment of the self but its proper ordering in relation to God.
